items.info: Overhead Panel. Connects the main battery to the standby electrical system.
items.label: Battery

items.info: Overhead Panel. Backup electrical bus that keeps the standby instruments alive if main power drops out.
items.label: Standby Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Both left and right ground power switches used when a GPU is connected.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Hold the selector to START to spin up the Auxiliary Power Unit.
items.label: APU

items.info: Overhead Panel. Connects the APU generator to the electrical buses.
items.label: APU Generator

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the airline logo on the tail. Usually on at night.
items.label: Logo Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Red on the left wingtip, green on the right, white at the tail. Required anytime the aircraft is powered.
items.label: NAV Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. The Inertial Reference System needs about 10 minutes to align at typical latitudes.
items.label: IRS Selectors

items.info: Overhead Panel. Heats the cockpit windows to prevent fogging at altitude and improve bird-strike resilience.
items.label: Window Heat

items.info: Overhead Panel. Uses bleed air to automatically heat the wing leading edges when ice is detected.
items.label: Wing Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. Protects the engine cowls and fan blades from ice ingestion.
items.label: Engine Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. Damps out dutch roll, the wallowing yaw-roll oscillation typical of swept-wing jets.
items.label: Yaw Damper

items.info: Overhead Panel. Arms the floor-path lighting to activate automatically if cabin power is lost.
items.label: Emergency Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Lets the electrical system automatically isolate buses if a generator drops out.
items.label: Bus Tie

items.info: Overhead Panel. Arms the engine-driven generators to pick up the electrical load once the engines are running.
items.label: Generator Control

items.info: Overhead Panel. Powers galleys, in-seat outlets, and other passenger amenities.
items.label: Utility L & R

items.info: Overhead Panel. Air conditioning packs that take hot bleed air and turn it into cool, pressurised cabin air.
items.label: Pack 1+2+3

items.info: Overhead Panel. Allows individual cabin temperature zones to be heated or cooled separately.
items.label: Trim Air

items.info: Overhead Panel. Recirculates cabin air to reduce the load on the air conditioning packs.
items.label: Recirc Fans

items.info: Overhead Panel. Provides bleed air from the APU for engine start and air conditioning.
items.label: APU Bleed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Engine bleeds OFF for APU-assisted engine start.
items.label: Engine Bleeds

items.info: Overhead Panel. Opens crossfeed valves, allowing fuel from any tank to feed any engine.
items.label: Crossfeed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify all pump switches off during cockpit preparation. They get turned on in Pre-Start before engine start.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: Pedestal. Program the Flight Management Computer with route, weights, and performance data.
items.label: FMC Preflight

items.info: Pedestal. Get the current weather and airport information via ACARS or radio.
items.label: ATIS

items.info: Pedestal. Obtain IFR clearance from Air Traffic Control.
items.label: ATC Clearance

items.info: Forward Panel. Verify the total fuel loaded matches the flight plan requirements.
items.label: Fuel Quantity

items.info: Pedestal. Set the horizontal stabilizer trim for takeoff based on the center of gravity.
items.label: Stab Trim

items.info: Pedestal. Ensure trim settings are neutral before flight.
items.label: Rudder & Aileron Trim

items.info: Forward Panel. Set to the local altimeter setting for accurate altitude below the transition level.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: MCP. Displays guidance cues on the Primary Flight Display for the pilot to follow.
items.label: Flight Director

items.info: MCP. Arms the autothrottle system to manage engine thrust automatically.
items.label: Autothrust

items.info: MCP. Set the initial airspeed, heading, and altitude targets for departure.
items.label: MCP Bugs

items.info: MCP. Arms Lateral Navigation and Vertical Navigation modes for the flight path.
items.label: LNAV / VNAV

items.info: MCP. Limits the maximum bank angle the autopilot uses during turns.
items.label: Bank Limit

items.info: MCP. The disconnect bar must be up to allow autopilot engagement.
items.label: Autopilot DISC Bar

items.info: Forward Panel. Verify the independent digital backup displays airspeed, altitude, and attitude.
items.label: Standby Flight Display

items.info: Forward Panel. RTO (Rejected Takeoff) automatically applies maximum braking if the takeoff is aborted.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Pedestal. Lever is fully forward to retract the spoilers.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: Pedestal. Verify thrust levers are at idle.
items.label: Throttles

items.info: Pedestal. Verify the flap lever matches the current physical flap position.
items.label: Flap Lever

items.info: Pedestal. Fuel control switches to CUTOFF.
items.label: Fuel Control

items.info: Center Pedestal. Prevents the aircraft from rolling during prep.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Pedestal. Enter the assigned squawk code.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates passenger seat belt signs when gear is down or flaps are extended.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Overhead Panel. EICAS indication confirms all cabin and cargo doors are secured.
items.label: Doors

items.info: Overhead Panel. Controls the engine-driven and demand hydraulic pumps.
items.label: Hydraulic Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Disconnects ground power before taxiing.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Main and override pumps on before engine start. Center and stab pumps on only if those tanks have fuel.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Red flashing lights on the top and bottom of the fuselage. Turned on before engine start to warn ground crew.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign ON.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Pedestal. Communicate with ground control via VHF or intercom to coordinate pushback.
items.label: Pushback Clearance

items.info: Pedestal. Released for pushback or set at the gate.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Pulling the start switch opens the start valve to spin the engine with bleed air.
items.label: Engine 4 Start

items.info: Pedestal. Switch moved to RUN to introduce fuel and ignite the engine at max motoring speed.
items.label: Engine 4 Fuel

items.info: Forward Panel. Watch the EICAS for oil pressure, N1 rotation, and a stable EGT.
items.label: Engine 4 Monitor

items.info: Overhead Panel and Pedestal. Start the remaining engines.
items.label: Engines 2, 3, 1

items.info: Forward Panel. Verify engine parameters are normal and no warning messages exist.
items.label: EICAS

items.info: Overhead Panel. Supplies engine bleed air to the pneumatic system after start.
items.label: Engine Bleeds

items.info: Overhead Panel. Verify that engine generators have picked up the electrical load.
items.label: Generators

items.info: Overhead Panel. Disconnects the APU generator.
items.label: APU Generator

items.info: Overhead Panel. Shuts down the APU once engine generators are running.
items.label: APU

items.info: Overhead Panel. Manual override if icing conditions exist on the ground.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Yoke and Pedestal. Move the control column and rudder pedals to confirm full and free movement.
items.label: Flight Controls

items.info: Pedestal. Extend the trailing edge flaps and leading edge slats to the required takeoff position.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Cockpit Door. Secured prior to departure for security.
items.label: Flight Deck Door

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the taxiway ahead.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Angled lights that illuminate intersecting taxiways.
items.label: Runway Turnoff Lights

items.info: Pedestal. Gently apply toe brakes during initial taxi to verify stopping capability.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Forward Panel. Confirm altimeters, heading, and attitude indicators are functioning correctly without flags.
items.label: Flight Instruments

items.info: Overhead Panel. High-intensity flashing white lights on the wingtips and tail. Turned on when entering an active runway.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. High-intensity forward-facing lights used for takeoff, landing, and operations below 10,000 feet.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the airline logo on the tail. Usually on at night.
items.label: Logo Lights

items.info: Pedestal. Sets Traffic Advisory and Resolution Advisory to enable full TCAS functionality.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Pedestal. Turned on to detect precipitation and storm cells.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Forward Panel. Verify the EICAS shows flaps at the commanded takeoff position.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Forward Panel. Flight Mode Annunciator at the top of the PFD confirms autopilot and autothrottle modes.
items.label: FMA

items.info: MCP. Verify correct speeds, heading, and initial altitude.
items.label: MCP

items.info: Pedestal. Release toe brakes when cleared for takeoff.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Pedestal. Press the Takeoff/Go-Around switches to command takeoff thrust.
items.label: Throttles

items.info: Yoke. Pull back on the control column to lift the nose at the calculated rotate speed.
items.label: Rotate

items.info: Forward Panel. Retract the landing gear once a positive rate of climb is established.
items.label: Positive Climb

items.info: Forward Panel. Verify the EICAS shows flaps are fully retracted.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: MCP. Engages the autopilot to follow the flight director guidance.
items.label: Autopilot

items.info: Forward Panel. Turned off after takeoff.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Overhead Panel. Manual override if icing conditions exist on the ground.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turned off after takeoff or upon arriving at the gate.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turned off after takeoff.
items.label: Runway Turnoff Lights

items.info: Forward Panel. Confirm all landing gear indications show up and locked.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Forward Panel. Verify the EICAS shows flaps are fully retracted.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turned off above 10,000 feet.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turned off after landing during daytime or post-flight.
items.label: Logo Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign ON below 10,000 ft or during turbulence.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Forward Panel. Set to standard pressure (1013 hPa / 29.92 inHg) when passing the transition altitude.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign ON below 10,000 ft or during turbulence.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: FMC. Verify the calculated point where the aircraft must begin descending to meet altitude restrictions.
items.label: Top Of Descent

items.info: Forward Panel. Flight Mode Annunciator at the top of the PFD confirms autopilot and autothrottle modes.
items.label: FMA

items.info: Pedestal. Get the weather and runway information for the destination airport.
items.label: Arrival ATIS

items.info: Cockpit. Review the approach chart, minimums, and missed approach procedure.
items.label: Approach Briefing

items.info: Pedestal. Select the arrival route and instrument approach in the Flight Management Computer.
items.label: FMC Approach

items.info: Pedestal. Tune the Instrument Landing System localizer frequency.
items.label: ILS Frequency

items.info: Forward Panel. Set the auto-braking level (1-4 or MAX AUTO) depending on runway length and conditions.
items.label: Autobrake

items.info: Forward Panel. Set the Decision Altitude (DA) or Minimum Descent Altitude (MDA).
items.label: Minimums

items.info: FMC. Program a holding pattern if instructed by ATC.
items.label: Holding

items.info: MCP. Set the altitude for the initial approach fix.
items.label: Approach Altitude

items.info: MCP. Initiate the descent via VNAV or flight level change.
items.label: Descent

items.info: Overhead Panel. High-intensity forward-facing lights used for takeoff, landing, and operations below 10,000 feet.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: MCP. Reduce airspeed to 250 knots below 10,000 feet as per standard regulations.
items.label: Speed

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign ON.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Forward Panel. Set to the local altimeter setting for accurate altitude below the transition level.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: Forward Panel. Verify the ILS frequency and identifier are active on the Primary Flight Display.
items.label: ILS Frequency

items.info: Forward Panel. Switch back to local altimeter setting when descending below the transition level.
items.label: Altimeters

items.info: MCP. Arms the localizer and glideslope for the ILS approach.
items.label: Approach Mode

items.info: MCP. Set the go-around altitude once the aircraft has captured the glideslope.
items.label: Missed Approach Altitude

items.info: Pedestal. Extends leading edge slats and trails edge flaps slightly.
items.label: Flaps 1

items.info: Pedestal. Extend flaps to position 5.
items.label: Flaps 5

items.info: Pedestal. Extend flaps to position 10.
items.label: Flaps 10

items.info: Pedestal. Extend flaps to position 20.
items.label: Flaps 20

items.info: Forward Panel. Extend the landing gear when intercepting the glideslope or reaching the final approach fix.
items.label: Gear

items.info: Pedestal. Usually set to 25 or 30 for landing.
items.label: Landing Flaps

items.info: Pedestal. Pull the lever into the armed detent so spoilers deploy automatically on touchdown.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: Pedestal. Verify thrust levers are at idle.
items.label: Throttles

items.info: Yoke. Pitch the nose up slightly to about 5-6 degrees just before touchdown to reduce the descent rate.
items.label: Flare

items.info: Pedestal. Deploys thrust reversers to direct exhaust air forward and slow the aircraft.
items.label: Reverse Thrust

items.info: Pedestal. Stow the reversers as the aircraft slows to taxi speed to prevent engine compressor stalls.
items.label: Reverse

items.info: Pedestal. Apply manual braking once the autobrake is disengaged.
items.label: Brakes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the taxiway ahead.
items.label: Taxi Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turned off above 10,000 feet.
items.label: Landing Lights

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turned off when vacating the runway.
items.label: Strobes

items.info: Overhead Panel. Illuminates the airline logo on the tail. Usually on at night.
items.label: Logo Lights

items.info: Pedestal. Lever is fully forward to retract the spoilers.
items.label: Speed Brake

items.info: Pedestal. Fully retract the flaps and slats during taxi-in.
items.label: Flaps

items.info: Pedestal. Turned off post-flight.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: Pedestal. Turned off post-flight so ground crew are not irradiated.
items.label: Weather Radar

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turned off after landing if no longer in icing conditions.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Overhead Panel. Leave running or connect external power at the gate.
items.label: APU

items.info: Pedestal. Pull the handle to keep the aircraft stationary.
items.label: Parking Brake

items.info: Pedestal. Fuel control switches to CUTOFF to shut down engines.
items.label: Fuel Control

items.info: Overhead Panel. Engine bleeds OFF after shutdown.
items.label: Engine Bleeds

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turned off post-flight to depressurise the system.
items.label: Hydraulic Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turned off post-flight once engines spool down.
items.label: Fuel Pumps

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turned off once engines have spooled down.
items.label: Beacon

items.info: Overhead Panel. Seatbelt sign OFF.
items.label: Seatbelt Sign

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turned off after shutdown.
items.label: Window Heat

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turned off after landing if no longer in icing conditions.
items.label: Anti-Ice

items.info: Pedestal. Turned off post-flight.
items.label: Transponder

items.info: MCP. Clears the guidance cues from the displays post-flight.
items.label: Flight Director

items.info: Cockpit Door. Unlocked once parked to allow ground crew and cabin crew access.
items.label: Cockpit Door

items.info: Overhead Panel. Powers down the navigation gyros and sensors.
items.label: IRS Selectors

items.info: Overhead Panel. Packs OFF for engine start.
items.label: Pack 1+2+3

items.info: Overhead Panel. Turned off during shutdown.
items.label: Recirc Fans

items.info: Overhead Panel. Leave running or connect external power at the gate.
items.label: APU

items.info: Overhead Panel. Reconnects ground power upon arrival at the gate.
items.label: External Power

items.info: Overhead Panel. Disconnects the battery and completely powers down the aircraft.
items.label: Battery

description: The Queen of the Skies, instantly recognizable by its iconic upper-deck that defined aviation for generations.
